metaDescription: Shopify store for RIOS, a multi-brand beauty and lingerie retailer in Pakistan: category search, deep menus, brand filters, product compare and quick buy.
summary: Shopify store for a multi-brand cosmetics, skincare, lingerie and fragrance retailer.
overview: RIOS describes itself as a multi-brand online shop for cosmetics, beauty, skincare and women's undergarments. We built the RIOS Shopify store to carry a large catalog from many brands, from Flormar and L'Oreal makeup to the Belleza lingerie line.
challenge: A multi-brand beauty store has to serve two kinds of shoppers: those who know the brand they want and those who only know the product type, such as a primer or a hair mask. Makeup, skincare, hair care, personal care, lingerie and electronics all need their own deep menus.
approach: A search bar with a category selector sits at the top, above a purple menu bar for sale, new arrivals, makeup, skin care, hair care, personal care, lingerie, fragrances, electronics and brands. The home page mixes promo carousels, a Chosen For You row, featured brands, latest arrivals and a brand strip. Collection pages add price and brand filters, a compare toggle and grid or list views, and product pages keep add to cart and buy it now side by side.
outcome: A busy, promotion-led Shopify store where shoppers can search by category, filter by brand and compare products across a wide beauty and lingerie range. The same menus, search and filters carry over to mobile, where the header search stays in view.

process.title: Navigation
process.body: Each department opens a menu of sub-categories, such as face, eyes, lips and nails under makeup, with a separate brands menu for shoppers who start from a label.

process.title: Search
process.body: A wide search bar with a category dropdown and rotating placeholder suggestions sits in the header on desktop and mobile.

process.title: Collections
process.body: Collection pages show a price slider, brand checkboxes with counts, sorting, a compare toggle and grid or list layouts.

process.title: Home page merchandising
process.body: Promo sliders, curated product rows, featured brand banners and themed sections like hair care essentials give the team places to run campaigns.

whyItMatters: In multi-brand beauty retail, shoppers arrive with either a brand or a need in mind. A store that supports both routes keeps them from leaving to search elsewhere.

faqs.q: What platform is the RIOS store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Enterprise theme, using collections for categories and brands, storefront filters and a review widget.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for multi-brand retailers, including deep category menus, brand filters and campaign-ready home pages. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
